principle_violations.reason: The Circle and Square classes implement a volume method that throws an UnsupportedOperationException, which violates the Liskov Substitution Principle. A client using these objects expects them to have a well-defined behavior for the volume calculation in the Shape interface.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate volume calculation into a distinct interface for volumetric shapes and only implement it in concrete classes capable of calculating volume.

principle_violations.reason: The Shape interface enforces implementation of a volume method across all shapes, including those that don't have a volume, like Circle and Square. This violates the Interface Segregation Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Split the Shape interface into two separate interfaces: one for area calculation and another for volume calculation. Classes should implement only the interfaces relevant to them.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
